q: Blood group is generally which measurement scale?
why: Blood group categories have no inherent order.

q: Celsius temperature is an interval scale because:
options: Differences are meaningful but zero is arbitrary
why: Celsius has meaningful differences but zero does not represent absence of temperature.

q: A blank laboratory result should normally be interpreted as:
options: Not observed in the dataset; investigate why
why: Missingness is not equivalent to zero, normal or negative.
A count of admissions takes discrete integer values.

q: Why must a laboratory value include units and context?
options: To increase the number of columns
Because the same number can mean different things across units, methods and specimens
why: A numeric result without analyte, unit and relevant context cannot be interpreted safely.
